retro-anime-master: Hand-painted anime film background of a narrow late-night animation workshop loft above a rain-washed city. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain dark graphite plaster wall, softly lit, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge a tall rain-streaked window shows the city at night and a distant elevated train crossing on a rail line; below it a small wooden desk with stacked blank drawing sheets, a warm amber desk lamp and a small glowing CRT monitor making a soft pool of cyan light. Faint rose and cyan reflections on the wet glass, muted graphite palette with small amber accents.
atelier-master: Hand-painted anime film background of a warm artist's drafting room in the evening. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain cream plaster wall in soft shadow, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge a walnut drafting desk with blank cream paper, a brushed-metal desk lamp with amber light and a linen curtain beside a tall open doorway onto a quiet courtyard with a small tree. Charcoal, cream, walnut and amber palette, tactile linen and paper textures.
sakura-master: Hand-painted anime film background of a dark timber illustration room looking onto a blossom courtyard after rain. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain dark plum-toned plaster wall, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge an open wooden sliding window frames a cherry tree in full blossom in a wet stone courtyard, a few petals drifting outside the window only; a low ink-stained timber desk with blank paper beneath it. Plum, dusty rose and warm dark timber palette, restrained botanical atmosphere.
minimal-pro-master: Minimal architectural interior painted as an anime film background: graphite walls, ivory paper and diffuse skylight from above. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain smooth graphite wall, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge one pale desk with a single sheet of blank ivory paper under a soft rectangle of daylight. Almost monochrome graphite and ivory palette, precise and calm, no decoration, no neon.
